performance.scope: Prospective archived player-contract research whose kickoff preceded this evaluation by at least six hours; separate from upcoming predictions, the historical home-win benchmark and personal wagering performance.
performance.message: Insufficient prospective settled player-contract evidence. Upcoming forecasts are not historical observations. Calibration, Brier scores and market superiority are not invented.

coverage.policy: Every latest eligible forecast older than six hours needs a verified binary or void outcome. Unresolved cases block calibration; six hours is a maturation grace period, not proof a game finished.

performance.selection: Latest eligible snapshot per exact contract and model version; canonical YES target; no outcome-dependent selection.
limitations: Game-block intervals account for within-game dependence, not source errors, model misspecification or every selection bias.
Only verified prospective binary outcomes enter accuracy/calibration metrics. Voids and retrospective imports remain separately counted.
Market comparisons use the same eligible contracts; unavailable prices are not inferred.
Direct DraftKings contract retrieval is verified only if an authorized provider actually returned its contracts; an unavailable feed is not replaced.
The explicitly opted-in Kalshi run tests a separate platform, not equivalent DraftKings prices or settlement rules.
Raw simulations and model sensitivity are not validated calibration; unsupported costs or settlement cases withhold unconditional value.
Physical iPhone Safari installation, authenticated account workflows and real generative assistant testing are separate checks.
